definitions.explanation: Returning something that was given or granted, such as a title, privilege, or reputation. Often used figuratively to mean overcoming a negative label or proving something wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返上|へんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧{返上|へんじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んだ→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: I worked on it, giving up my days off.

examples.japanese: {弱小|じゃくしょう}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返上|へんじょう}し、⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: They shed their reputation as a weak team and brilliantly won the championship.

notes:
{返上|へんじょう} is a noun that can function as a suru verb ({返上|へんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). It literally means returning something upward (to a superior), but is most commonly used figuratively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧{返上|へんじょう} (clearing a bad reputation)
- ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧{返上|へんじょう} (giving up holidays/days off)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{返上|へんじょう} (forfeiting an honor)
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返上|へんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (relinquish a title)

The expression ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧{返上|へんじょう} (clearing one's name) is extremely common and is often the first context in which learners encounter this word. ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧{返上|へんじょう} (working through holidays) appears frequently in work-related discussions.
